bmc-roadmachine-01: Compliant but lively, with wide tire room; pricey and heavy.
bmc-roadmachine-x: Fast and sharp on pavement and light gravel; weak in mud.
bmc-teammachine-r-01: Fast, stiff and sharp on flats; firm on rough roads.
bmc-teammachine-slr: Comfortable, stiff and snappy; stock wheels are basic.
bmc-teammachine-slr-01: Stiff, fast and sharp; firm ride and a steep price.
bmc-urs: Loved geometry for rough gravel; pricey next to rivals.
bmc-urs-01: Smooths rough gravel and washboard; gearing spins out.
bmc-urs-al: Planted, good value; the reach runs long.
cannondale-caad14: Sharp, snappy alloy racer; builds seen as poor value.
cannondale-jekyll: Composed and grippy on steep descents; heavy on climbs.
cannondale-scalpel: Fast, efficient climber and sharp handler; dropper gripes.
cannondale-scalpel-ht: Very light, fast climber; harsh on rough descents.
cannondale-superx: Fast, lively race gravel bike; firm on the stock tires.
cannondale-trail: Tough beginner hardtail; basic parts limit rougher trails.
canyon-aeroad-cfr: Stiff, fast and stable; the low, racy fit is not for all.
canyon-lux-trail-cf: Light, efficient climber, confident down; a bit heavy.
canyon-spectral-cf: Playful all-rounder that climbs well; reach runs big.
cervelo-s5: Very fast, steady in crosswinds; toe overlap annoys some.
cervelo-soloist: Sharp handling, good value; heavy wheels and wide bars.
giant-contend-ar: Comfortable, versatile with big tire room; seatpost irks some.
giant-reign-advanced-pro: Lively, composed and climbs well; brakes and storage lag.
giant-stance: Great-value, climbs well; brakes and bars need upgrades.
giant-tcr-advanced-pro: Light, snappy and good value; hookless rims limit tires.
pivot-firebird: Balanced enduro bike that climbs well; pricey and stiff.
pivot-shadowcat: Playful, lively and climbs well; small wheels in chunk.
pivot-switchblade: Agile, poppy and capable; expensive, with limited wheel swaps.
pivot-trailcat-lt: Climbs well and plays well downhill; very pricey.
pivot-trailcat-sl: Climbs fast and tracks rough ground; a bit heavy.
santa-cruz-5010: Playful, precise handling; weak brakes and a high price.
santa-cruz-bronson: Planted on steep trails and climbs well; some chain slap.
santa-cruz-hightower: Confident descender that climbs well; many call it pricey.
santa-cruz-megatower: Stable and composed in rough terrain; heavy and stiff.
santa-cruz-tallboy: Composed, lively and calm on climbs; pricey.
santa-cruz-v10: Huge grip and composed speed; fork setup takes patience.
specialized-aethos-2: Light and comfortable on hills; stock tires and wheels lag.
specialized-chisel: Light, efficient and good value; stock parts are heavy.
specialized-rockhopper: Dependable starter hardtail; basic fork and quick-release hubs.
specialized-s-works-epic-9: Very light, fast XC racer; the price and routing draw gripes.
specialized-stumpjumper-15: Versatile, plush and climbs well; a few find it nervous in chunk.
trek-check-out-sl: Smooths rough gravel; heavy and overkill on smooth ground.
trek-fuel-ex-gen-7: Versatile and confident, climbs well; alloy builds are heavy.
yeti-asr: Smooth, grippy and light; alloy wheels on a pricey build.
yeti-sb115: Great technical climber; nervous when speeds and chunk rise.
yeti-sb120: Climbs well, descends big; heavy, with no storage.
yeti-sb135: Nimble and playful, climbs well; blunt in chunk and pricey.
